steps.en: Outstanding notices of company hirers at the third letter are collected
steps.id: Notice outstanding hirer company di surat ketiga dikumpulkan untuk batch hari itu

steps.en: Each company hirer is recognised once in the day's batch
steps.id: Tiap hirer company dikenali satu kali di batch hari itu
steps.why_en: The same company can still land in two groups when due dates differ, and so get more than one email.
steps.why_id: Company yang sama masih bisa masuk dua grup kalau due date berbeda, sehingga menerima lebih dari satu email.

steps.en: Only company hirers with an email address get the email
steps.id: Hanya hirer company yang punya alamat email yang menerima email

steps.en: The email lists all outstanding notices of the company together
steps.id: Email memuat semua notice outstanding milik company secara bergabung

steps.en: The email mentions the third letter the company received
steps.id: Email menyebut surat ketiga yang diterima company
steps.why_en: Nothing in the system adds a reference to the letter; it depends on the saved email wording.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada proses yang menambahkan rujukan ke surat; hanya bergantung pada isi teks email yang tersimpan.

steps.en: The email is sent out to the company hirer
steps.id: Email dikirim keluar ke hirer company
steps.why_en: The scheduled job and email sending are both switched off in production settings, so nothing is sent.
steps.why_id: Job terjadwal dan pengiriman email sama-sama dimatikan di setting produksi, jadi tidak ada yang terkirim.
